arguments.content: Independent client/provider rollout: distinguish a requested application receipt from negotiated provider support. Sending require_receipt does not establish that an older provider implements it; a provider may apply the write and return its legacy success shape, after which a strict new client reports failure. A disabled UI feature flag provides no protection if the shared save path unconditionally demands the receipt. Review both persisted state and caller-visible success against the supported provider's actual release source, and retain a legacy-provider regression test alongside receipt-capable mocks. Introduce strict receipt semantics only with an explicit compatibility/capability strategy; pending provider work cannot satisfy independently releasable client requirements. Observed P1 in enhanced-settings task 1: staged client versus eval-release 22140737b2bc5792b535f3f8ce16f7fa162101db; base HEAD saves succeeded, staged saves applied values but raised on missing applied, including retries.
